intro: Your active bids and reserved watches, together. Every amount and status comes from the service that owns it.
payment_unknown: Payment status unknown — not confirmed paid
pendingNotice: Pending or unconfirmed reservation requests stay in Checkout until Orders acknowledges them.
emptyBids: No active bids yet. Find a watch and join a live auction.
unavailable: Temporarily unavailable. Your activity has not been changed.
signIn: Sign in to see your activity
accessDenied: Your current account cannot use buyer actions.
signInBody: This private workspace only shows your own bids and reservations.
paymentUnavailable: Payment and delivery are not available yet. This is not a paid order.
resultsUnavailable: Final auction results will appear when auction closing is available.
more: More activity is available in the owning service.
privacy: Only you can see your ceiling. We compete only as needed, never above it. Earlier equal maximums take priority.
quoted: Review the preview, then confirm your private maximum.
quoteUnavailable: A current fee preview is unavailable. No bid was submitted.
quoteExpired: The preview expired. Review a new preview before confirming.
quoteBasis: Fee preview at your maximum, not a payment or a final auction price.
acknowledged: Maximum accepted. The displayed price may be below your ceiling.
invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with no more than two decimal places.
denied: Bid not accepted. Review the auction's current price, access and end time.
stale: The auction changed. Refresh before confirming a new maximum.
uncertain: Submission could not be confirmed. Retry the same request to check its outcome; do not assume it was rejected.
offline: You are offline. Bids cannot be placed or queued.
